previewPolicy: Cards/printings in hSD20 and hSD21 retain preview=true before their official 2026-10-30 Japan release date. Card release status and individual printing status must be kept separate for reprints.

listingFiles.timeBasis: Local file write time after retrieval; the initial capture did not retain HTTP Date headers. This is not an independent server timestamp.

deltaDetailFiles.timeBasis: Local file write time after retrieval; the initial capture did not retain HTTP Date headers. This is not an independent server timestamp.

initialCaptureProvenance.note: Fresh listing files were first captured in this newly-created directory, then cached locally for schema2 enrichment during the same audit. Snapshot bytes remain frozen; future fetches default to network and explicit --resume records cache reuse/source timestamps.

structuredAudit.method: Read-only comparison of HP/LIFE/stage/color/baton/Arts base damage, printed modifier, cost, special targets and values. Color aliases/composites and blank/zero baton normalized. No translated effect-prose rewrite.

legacyMissingPrintedPlus.classification: Legacy display metadata omission, not a newly observed erratum; existing translated effects and gameplay data preserved.
